name: LumenicMenu
author: LensError
description: Replaces the ChilloutVR Main Menu and Quick Menu with a native Rust UI built on Lumenic. Includes live settings search, Quick Menu pinning, UILib/UIExpansionKit mod bridges, and independent menu toggles.
changelog: Added full MelonLoader C# Extension API (LumenicMenu.Api) with custom Quick Menu / Main Menu tabs, shared Extensions hub, declarative UiBuilder with styled dropdowns/comboboxes and masked password inputs, named section injection/override/replacement, global theme/layout/font overrides, live Texture2D uploads, Text Size presets (75%/100%/125%/150%), Support & Update Check tab, system alerts forwarding, and updated Lumenic v0.1.4.
